title: Business Central 2025 wave 2 (BC27): Add LockTimeoutDuration allow increasing/lowering lock timeout instead of only disabling/enabling it (New Database.LockTimeoutDuration Method)
summary: Business Central 2025 wave 2 (BC27) introduces a new Database.LockTimeoutDuration method that allows developers to adjust lock timeout duration in seconds rather than simply enabling or disabling it, useful for long-running processes that need flexible timeout control.
key_points: New Database.LockTimeoutDuration method gets or sets lock timeout duration in seconds instead of just toggling on/off
Setting a lock timeout of 0 or less disables the lock timeout
Designed for long-running processes like overnight batch jobs that need timeout flexibility
Requires runtime version 16.0 or greater, not available in version 15.0
Method can be invoked without specifying the data type name

quotes.text: Gets or sets the current lock timeout duration in seconds. Setting a lock timeout of 0 or less disables the lock timeout.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core functionality of the new method and how to disable timeout completely

quotes.text: This method has been designed specifically for use in long-running processes that should not be terminated because of a lock time-out.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the intended use case for this new capability
